guarantees.claim: The combinational assign continuously drives {incr, incr_err, mr_err, ctr_i_slice} with the value of in_buf; these outputs always mirror in_buf.

uncertain_points.claim: The error flags incr_err and mr_err are directly routed from in_buf; the logic that generates valid error conditions is in the source of in_buf (not shown). Verification of error handling requires analysis of that source.
uncertain_points.cond: when downstream logic interprets incr_err or mr_err as active error indicators
uncertain_points.risk: If in_buf carries stale, glitched, or deliberately false error flags, the FSM or consumer may miss or mishandle real errors.
